items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01
items.q: That's a black and tan. Me, Mineta, and Udel.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. Teaching everything. That's right. He really is a professor. Yeah. He was a professor with Mineta, oh I'm just using a bone then. That's a black and tan. Me, Mineta, and Udel. Remember Udel, you heard the other one with Udel? Wilson. He's a piano player. He died I think. Now Udel. And now he's B-Gard. And then we had this guy Montoya playing trumpet with us. That's years ago. That's the time the district was open then. Where was that black and tan? It was on Abbeyville Street, around Burgundy…
